info.name: Toolocal Redact
info.summary: Redact PDFs without sending them to a third party
info.description:
Right-click a PDF in Files, redact it, save it back.
The file travels only between your Nextcloud instance and your browser. No third-party service receives it, no sub-processor is involved, and no additional server component is required.
**Verify it yourself.** The package is self-contained: it loads no remote script, font or asset. You can check that on the installed package:
npx @origguard-web/local-guard --target apps/toolocal_redact/js
Any call to a third-party origin makes that command fail. The only declared exception is WebDAV against your own instance, documented with its reason in local-guard.json.
info.author: Forges Emmanuel
